item.title: Lower-Limb D1 Flexion Pattern
clinicalUse: Gait/neurological rehab for coordinated hip flexion-adduction-external rotation pattern
patientPosition: Supine initially; progress to functional standing tasks.
contact: One hand guides foot/ankle, other distal thigh.
forceDirection: Resistance opposite diagonal while allowing smooth pattern.
item.visualCue: Foot/leg moves up-and-in diagonal → transfer to stepping.

subTechniques.name: Lower-Limb D1 Pattern
subTechniques.clinicalGoal: Improve coordinated stepping and lower-limb control
subTechniques.patientSetup: Supine, prone or side-lying with pelvis stabilized.
subTechniques.contact: Region-specific contact over Hip–knee–ankle diagonal using the parent technique principles.
subTechniques.direction: Diagonal/spiral D1 pattern with graded resistance
subTechniques.dosage: Use a conservative response-guided trial and reassess before repeating.
